name: Strip Motion Blur
description: Directional motion blur on the scrolling strip. The blur follows the scroll speed and fades out as the strip settles.
author: PlasmaZones

parameters.name: Blur Strength
parameters.description: How far the blur smears at a given scroll speed.

parameters.name: Edge Feather
parameters.description: How softly the blur fades out at the edges of the strip area.
